title: B.P.R.D. Collectible Ring — Hellboy II: The Golden Army
description:
Official B.P.R.D.-themed collectible ring associated with Hellboy II: The Golden Army (2008), Guillermo del Toro’s sequel starring Ron Perlman. The ring takes its identity from the Bureau for Paranormal Research and Defense, the fictional agency at the heart of the Hellboy universe. A compact piece of movie-era memorabilia, it reflects the wave of licensed collectibles released around the film, from figures to prop replicas.
